name: Editorial Desk
icp_fit: World's leading architectural platform (DA 92). Features climate-responsive and vernacular sustainable design case studies.
pitch_angle: Empirical thermal comfort study: Rammed earth vs RCC in Western India summer heat.
pitch_subject: Editorial story pitch for ArchDaily South Asia: Empirical thermal comfort study
pitch_body:
Hi there, hope you're having a good week.

I'm Archana, principal architect at Anvitam Architecture & Ecological Design. I've been following ArchDaily South Asia's coverage on sustainable habitats and vernacular building.

We recently documented a completed case study on: Empirical thermal comfort study: Rammed earth vs RCC in Western India summer heat..

We have the high-res photography, thermal data sets, and architectural working drawings ready. I'd love to share the full package as an exclusive editorial contribution or guest feature for ArchDaily South Asia if this fits your upcoming editorial calendar.

A brief look at our completed work: https://www.anvitam.com/projects

If your editorial lineup is currently full, no problem at all. Feel free to keep us in mind for future ecological design stories.

Warmly,
Archana Gavas
Principal Architect, Anvitam Architecture & Ecological Design
